en.headline: Man dies after rescue off Hung Hom promenade
en.dek: Firefighters pulled an unconscious man from the water off Kin Wan Street on Thursday night; he was later confirmed dead at Queen Elizabeth Hospital.
body: A man died on Thursday night after he was rescued from the sea off the Hung Hom promenade, police and rescue crews said.

Officers were called at about 9:21pm after a person was seen in the water about 30 metres off the promenade at Kin Wan Street, according to reports citing the emergency call. Firefighters sent divers into the water and brought a man, described as being in his forties, ashore unconscious.

Ambulance crews took him to Queen Elizabeth Hospital and used an automatic chest-compression device on the way. Doctors in the accident and emergency department later confirmed he had died, Hong Kong 01 and Oriental Daily reported.
Police said they were investigating why he entered the water and were working to confirm his identity. No further details of the circumstances were released overnight.

zh.headline: 紅磡海濱男子墮海 送院後不治
zh.dek: 周四晚上約九時二十一分，建灣街海濱長廊對開有男子墮海，消防救起時已昏迷，送伊利沙伯醫院後證實不治。
body: 紅磡海濱周四晚發生墮海事故，一名男子獲救送院後不治。
據報，警方晚上約九時二十一分接獲途人報案，指建灣街紅磡海濱長廊對開約三十米海面有人載浮載沉。消防派出蛙人落海，救起一名約四十多歲男子，當時已昏迷。
救護員將他送往伊利沙伯醫院，途中使用自動心外壓機急救。香港01及東方日報報道，急症室醫生其後證實他不治。
警方表示正調查墮海原因，並核實死者身份。截至凌晨，當局未有公布更多詳情。
